Video-making-ai 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches an AI-powered video editing tool for quick highlight reel creation and export.
- Supports upload of MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Allows users to describe desired edits (e.g., "cut silences, add background music") for automatic processing.
- Provides easy video export in various formats, with cloud-based rendering for fast results.
- Includes session setup, free token generation, credits balance, and robust error handling.
